clips.end_words: a credit card and a charge card
clips.caption:
Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says a news article claimed Mark Cuban's card got declined on a $140,000 bottle of champagne. Mark Cuban doesn't carry a card balance - he used his Amex Centurion, not a credit card at all.

A charge card bills you in full, no option, 30 days later. A credit card lets you pay the minimum and charges interest on the rest. The media mixed them up and called it news.

Rich people use charge cards or pay cash. If you're carrying a credit card balance, you bought something you couldn't afford.

Do you know which card is in your wallet?

#kevintrudeau #creditcards #moneymindset #personalfinance #wealthmindset #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend who just watched a 'billionaire's card declined' headline sends this to the friend who believed it: proof the media didn't know what it was reporting on. Emotion: anger at being misled.

Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's Your Wish Is Your Command audios, free.

Kevin Trudeau says over 70% of California's $10 million-plus homes are bought in straight cash, no mortgage. The rich who do borrow don't take a loan to buy the house - they buy it outright, then open a line of credit against the equity instead.

Cars work the opposite way: pay cash or lease, never finance, because a new car loses 30% of its value in year one. A house can gain value. A car never does.

Same principle twice: don't go into debt for something that's losing value.

Which one are you getting backwards - the car or the house?

#kevintrudeau #realestate #wealthmindset #milliondollarhouse #personalfinance #yourwishisyourcommand
clips.send: A friend about to finance a new car sends this to the friend already underwater on one: proof the rich never borrow against something that loses value the second they buy it. Emotion: anxiety about money quietly leaking away.
